dogecoin.text: "Dogecoin joined the top five cryptocurrencies by market capitalization; with a market value exceeding $50B, Dogecoin is now bigger than Ford, Marriott, and other blue-chip companies!"
Dogecoin, the cryptocurrency that started as a joke has shot up more than 6,000% this year to a $40B total market value thanks to memes and hope for a big score—and it's still going!(?)
